blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As Manila Water gears up for the anticipated strong El Niño conditions, which may persist up to the first semester of 2027, the company is maximizing the capacity of its Cardona Water Treatment Plant (WTP) to help ensure a reliable and resilient water supply for customers across the East Zone. Located in Cardona, Rizal, the 100-million-liter-per-day facility draws raw water from Laguna Lake, providing Manila Water with an additional water source that complements supplies from Angat Dam and other facilities.
